name: Downloading
when: Saving a report, chart or file

variants.name: Arrow
variants.desc: A bold arrow drops in from above and lands with a little catch.

variants.name: Catch
variants.desc: A parcel falls onto its head and gets swallowed up.

variants.name: Progress
variants.desc: A bar fills underneath while its eyes follow the leading edge.

variants.name: Parachute
variants.desc: A parcel floats down on a parachute and lands on its head.

variants.name: Gulp
variants.desc: A stream of data bits pours in from above and it gulps them down.
